limitations: AI-assisted selected-source curation; human scientific review pending. No biological fit, causal estimate or operating specification.
Mouse E3.75 entry, elapsed source hours and author-assigned in-vivo resemblance remain separate; no human or later continuous gestation follows.

Recipient/fragment/litter identities and assay-withdrawal links remain unresolved. Supplementary Fig. 1B now provides exact embryo numerators/denominators within per-recipient 24h rates, but these rows do not identify later endpoints.
No ledger promotion. Original publisher bytes remain outside the candidate bundle. No tissue collection, culture protocol, device assembly, physiological setpoint or clinical guidance.

GEO sample metadata records pooled scRNA-seq embryo and uterine-site inputs separately from Figure 5 endpoint coverage. Pool counts, shared article/condition labels and assay timing do not authenticate overlap with later phenotype cohorts or quantify later-assessment withdrawals.

The approximate PDMS-ceiling-free author response is retained separately (~35%); the four exact workbook recipient-level fractions have an unweighted mean of 36.3%. The source response remains approximate and no identity or later-outcome link follows.

A separate source-reported failure condition under persistent PDMS coverage is retained qualitatively at 72h; the narrative gives no starting n, and the representative image is not a denominator or viability assay.

Article-reported 750 μm (95.8%) and 1500 μm (94.8%) attachment summaries are separate n=3 recipient-mouse means. Their exact workbook fractions reproduce the text values; SEM can be reconstructed descriptively, but the article reports no significant difference and no equivalence test is inferred.

Supplementary Fig. 1C adds eight per-recipient attachment rates for autologous and allogenic co-culture; the source reports P=0.8532 (ns), which does not establish equivalence, and supplies no recipient IDs or later-outcome linkage.

MOESM17 sheet 1D supplies twelve 24h recipient-level attachment fractions across four estrogen concentrations (n=3 recipients each). Reported one-way ANOVA/Tukey annotations are retained as source statements and were not recalculated; anonymous recipient IDs prevent cross-condition pairing.

MOESM17 sheet 1E supplies ten 24h recipient-level attachment fractions for the endometrial PMSG comparison (n=3 Natural, n=7 PMSG recipients). The workbook header spells the treatment PMGS; the figure and caption say PMSG. The unpaired-test annotation is retained without recalculation; recipient IDs are absent.

MOESM17 sheet 1F supplies six 24h recipient-level attachment fractions for the embryo PMSG comparison (n=3 per group). The workbook header spells the treatment PMGS; the panel and caption say PMSG. The reported unpaired-test annotation is retained without recalculation; recipient identities are not reported.

MOESM17 sheet 1G supplies twelve 24h recipient-level attachment fractions for Naturally hatched and AT-hatched embryos (n=6 per group). The source-reported P=0.3560 unpaired-test annotation is retained without recalculation; recipient identities are absent.

MOESM19 sheet 4E adds twelve 96h sole-culture morphogenesis-category formula rows for plastic/PDMS bottoms and with/without OCT4/CDX2 marker categories (caption n=3 independent samples per group; physical unit type unidentified). This is distinct from the 72h persistent PDMS-ceiling failure cohort and does not resolve its denominator.

MOESM15 sheets 6I-6K add 30 recipient-level formula records for 24h attachment, 24-48h shedding and 48h sustention. Sheets 6J/6K explicitly exclude some assay-withdrawn embryos with unavailable later status; the source supplies no withdrawal count or unit IDs, and same-numbered Exp rows do not establish transitions.

MOESM15 sheets 6F-6H add 21 normalized per-embryo pAKT/AKT fluorescence measurements with paired raw values retained as alternate representations; 6M adds 13 numeric embryo invasion volumes. The literal 6M D2 N/A is preserved with no inferred 100 μM group denominator or zero-valued outcome. Caption test annotations remain source statements, and group-local embryo labels do not establish linkage.

MOESM16 sheets 7H/7I add in-vivo dpc5.5 implantation-site counts per recipient mouse and site-weight values per embryo. Group totals of mouse counts equal the number of site weights in each condition, but no mouse-to-site crosswalk is provided. The caption reports 16 transfers per mouse; non-implantation fates and later development are not identified.
